air_get_quality.name: air_get_quality
air_get_quality.title: Get the air quality in Georgia
air_get_quality.description: Returns the newest air quality readings of the automatic stations of the National Environmental Agency of Georgia (NEA), for a city, one station, or every station. Each reading gives PM10, PM2.5, NO2, O3, SO2, or CO, its concentration (µg/m³, CO in mg/m³), its hour, and its level: good, fair, moderate, poor, or very_poor. A station level is its worst reading. Stations come worst first. A reading older than 24 hours is left out. The NEA stamps some readings a few hours ahead of the clock: the time is as published. Data from the NEA.

Use it for the price of petrol, diesel, or gas at a company today, or to compare companies. Each product has a grade that every company shares: regular (litre), premium (litre), super (litre), super_100 (litre), diesel (litre), cng (cubic_metre), lpg (litre), other (litre). price: the price in GEL of one unit at a station with an attendant. self_service_price: the price in GEL of one unit at a self-service station of the same company. A product with no self_service_price has none. The fuel companies of this server: connect (Connect, publishes no effective date), gulf (Gulf), lukoil (Lukoil), neogas (Neogas, publishes no effective date), portal (Portal, publishes no effective date), rompetrol (Rompetrol, publishes no effective date), socar (SOCAR, publishes no effective date), wissol (Wissol). The prices are of today. The tool has no history.

law_get_act.description: Returns one legal act of the Legislative Herald (matsne.gov.ge) by its identifier from law_search_acts. With no article, returns the metadata, the newest 20 consolidated versions with their publication dates, the count of every version, and the table of contents. With articles, returns the full text of at most 10 articles, for example 82 or 133^3 (article 133 with the superscript 3). Give a version number or a date to read the act as it stood then; the default is the newest version, or in English the newest translated version.
